newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Televisa chairman Azcarraga resigns.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Televisa chairman Azcarraga resigns.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Televisa SA, the Spanish-speaking world's largest media group, said late on Monday that Chairman and President Emilio Azcarraga Milmo would step down for health reasons.
The company said Chief Financial Officer Guillermo Canedo White would succeed Azcarraga as Chairman and also become chief corporate officer.
Azcarraga's son, Emilio Azcarraga Jean, currently executive vice president and chief operating officer, would succeed his father as president and also become chief executive, the company said.
The company said Azcarraga, 66, would assume the newly created position of founding chairman.
